title: Update on Internal Investigations into Police Officers Involved in Parti Liyani v PP 2020 SGHC 187 Case
what_it_is: Update on Internal Investigations into Police Officers Involved in Parti Liyani v PP 2020 SGHC 187 Case

sections.label: Police internal investigations completed
sections.summary: The Police's Internal Affairs Office completed internal investigations into the Police Investigation Officer and his supervisor.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: In respect of the case, the Police's Internal Affairs Office (IAO) has completed its internal investigations relating to the Police Investigation Officer (IO) and his supervisor.

sections.label: Officers found neglecting duties
sections.summary: The investigations found that both the IO and his supervisor had neglected their duties.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The investigations in this case found that both the IO and his supervisor had neglected their duties.

sections.label: Financial penalty for neglect of duty
sections.summary: A financial penalty at the medium range was imposed on both officers, and the Public Service Commission concurred.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: In the event, a financial penalty, equivalent to the medium range, was imposed on both officers for neglect of duty.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The Public Service Commission, as the authority for disciplinary control of civil servants, has concurred with the penalty imposed on both officers.

sections.label: Police morale and public confidence
sections.summary: Surveys show Police officers' morale is high and public confidence in the Police remains extremely high.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: Surveys – both internal as well as independent – show that the morale of Police officers is high.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: And public confidence in the Police force, despite some scurrilous attempts by some third parties to continuously run down the Police, remains extremely high.

sections.label: Fine and forgone increments
sections.summary: A fine was imposed plus a number of months of increment forgone, differing for the two officers, at the mid-point.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: In context, what happened is that a fine was imposed on them, plus, in addition, a number of months of increment are forgone.

sentences.speaker: Mr K Shanmugam
sentences.text: The number of months differs for the two officers but, as I have said, it is at the mid-point of what could have been imposed.
